title: New Notification 29.10.2026: New ACR format for Grade-1 Judicial Officers, Grade-II & Grade-III Judicial Officers and for Judicial Officers posted in exclusive Courts 30-10-2026

FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA SHILLONG
NOTIFICATION
Dated, Shillong 29th October,2026
No. HCM 11/400/2013/Estt/216: in terms of the resolution adopted in the meeting of
the Hon’ble Full Court held on 08.10.2026, the High Court of Meghalaya is pleased to
implement the new ACR format for Grade-1 Judicial Officers, Grade-II & Grade-III
Judicial Officers and for Judicial Officers posted in exclusive Courts with immediate
effect. Henceforth, the new ACR format(s) shall be utilized by the Judicial Officers in the
State as applicable and the 2022 ACR format for Judicial Officers in the State shall be
discontinued accordingly.
By order etc.,
/
REGISTRAR GENERAL
Memo.No. HCM I1/400/201 3/Estt/216-A
